suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 concerns unsafe deserialization of Kotlin build-cache metadata. Dependency-Check associates the finding with kotlin-stdlib, but the affected functionality is Kotlin build infrastructure rather than the JVM runtime code shipped by this application. The application does not execute or consume Kotlin compiler/build-cache metadata at runtime. Kotlin 2.4.20 is the documented fixed version, but it is not yet listed as a stable release at the time of this review (2.4.20-RC2 as of Aug 2026). Reassess when the fixed stable release is available. Note: this finding intermittently disappears/reappears across scan runs depending on NVD data cache state — do not remove this suppression based on a single clean scan.
